description: Read one contributor by public key. Read-only. surface profile (default) returns displayName, documents (at most 100), contributions (proposed edits and their review state) and inbox (open suggestions waiting for them). surface documents pages every public document that key owns, 30 a page, newest first, with total and hasMore; any public key works and no signature is needed. Do not use it to search documents. Review inbox items with heystack_review_suggestion.

key.description: Contributor Ed25519 public key, 43 characters. Pass this or publicKey. Never a private key.

limit.description: Documents per page for surface documents, 1 to 30.

page.description: Page number for surface documents, starting at 1.

surface.description: profile (default) is the profile summary. documents pages every public document the key owns.

name: heystack_read_profile
title: Read a contributor profile
